milestones.claim: Versioned full Task Context and content-addressed Prompt Envelope contracts exist and select full only.
milestones.doneMeans: A deterministic envelope can be recomputed and verified from canonical Story facts and known environment, while tampering or incremental requests fail closed.

milestones.claim: Story-aware full Prompt assembly is owned by the trusted agent_prompt CLI path.
milestones.doneMeans: The CLI prints the canonical full Prompt and envelope for a Story, rejects caller-spliced authority fields, and leaves role-only output byte-identical.

milestones.claim: ReviewRun, reviewer pass and lifecycle gates consume one fresh signed envelope binding.
milestones.doneMeans: Fresh evidence passes; replay across HEAD, round or ReviewRun is rejected with stable reasons; retry preserves ledger call identity and creates a fresh provider attempt ID.

milestones.claim: Role eligibility and legacy-full-context rollback are total and gate-safe.
milestones.doneMeans: Compatibility or retired evidence cannot satisfy REVIEW, assurance floor or quorum, and a per-role rollback restores exact legacy full Prompt bytes without loosening gates.
